extension.name: plg_system_claudecoworkapi
extension.author: Tracy
extension.description: Answers the Claude Cowork API door before Joomla routes the request, on the site and the administrator alike, and prints render stamps for Tracy's page picker on requests Tracy's site proxy marks. Installed and updated as part of the Claude Cowork package.

field.name: t3_offcanvas_a11y
field.label: Keyboard for T3 off-canvas drawers
field.description: ESC closes a T3 template's off-canvas drawer, focus stays in it while it is open and goes back to its button when it closes, and its close button is announced.
